connectorUiConfig.title: Microsoft Power Platform Admin Activity
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: Microsoft Power Platform is a low-code/no-code suite empowering both citizen and pro developers to streamline business processes by enabling the creation of custom apps, automation of workflows, and data analysis with minimal coding. The Power Platform Admin data connector provides the capability to ingest Power Platform administrator activity logs from the Microsoft Purview Audit log into Microsoft Sentinel.

sampleQueries.description: Microsoft Power Platform Admin Activity Logs

dataTypes.name: PowerPlatformAdminActivity
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
PowerPlatformAdminActivity
            | summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
            | where isnotempty(Time)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: Read and Write permissions are required.

Read permissions to shared keys for the workspace are required. [See the documentation to learn more about workspace keys](https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/platform/agent-windows#obtain-workspace-id-and-key)

customs.name: Tenant Permissions
customs.description: 'Security Administrator' or 'Global Administrator' on the workspace's tenant.

customs.name: Micorosft Purview Audit
customs.description: Microsoft Purview Audit (Standard or Premium) must be activated.

instructionSteps.title: Connect Microsoft Power Platform Admin Activity audit logs to Microsoft Sentinel
instructionSteps.description: This connector uses the Office Management API to get your Power Platform administrator audit logs. The logs will be stored and processed in your existing Microsoft Sentinel workspace. You can find the data in the **PowerPlatformAdminActivity** table.
